title: 1st Place - Guild Banner Competition
details: CSS won 1st place in the Guild Banner Competition during CITE Week 2026: Rise of the Digital Champions, with the theme "Coding the Future: Innovation, Collaboration, and Excellence". Certificate of Recognition given at the University Gymnasium, Nueva Vizcaya State University.

title: 1st Runner-Up - CITE Week 2026
details: 1st Runner-Up trophy from CITE Week 2026: Rise of the Digital Champions, College of Information Technology Education, Nueva Vizcaya State University.

title: FOMO Award
details: Given to Nexus Guild (Computer Science Department) for always wanting to take part in every activity during CITE Week 2026: Rise of the Digital Champions. Given at the ITE Building Hallway, Nueva Vizcaya State University.

title: BFF Award
details: Given to Nexus Guild (Computer Science Department) for always being supportive and a team player, even beyond the title, during CITE Week 2026: Rise of the Digital Champions. Given at the ITE Building Hallway, Nueva Vizcaya State University.
